summary: American Tower filed an 8-K on Sept. 14, 2026, reporting completion of a registered public offering of $1.6B senior unsecured notes across three tranches: 5.300% due 2031, 5.560% due 2033, and 5.750% due 2036, netting approximately $1,579.9M. The REIT intends to repay $600M of 1.450% notes due 2026 and outstanding revolver debt. No board recommendation or advisor was cited, and the filing is an ordinary debt-structuring action rather than a canonical special situation; watch for leverage metrics and refinancing cadence as rate-risk signals.
